_doc: FRB G.17 Industrial Production and Capacity Utilization. Dates AND time transcribed from the Board's own G.17 page, which lists 2026 and 2027: 'The monthly releases are issued at 9:15 a.m. The annual revision is issued at noon.' A monthly release carries the PREVIOUS month; the annual revision is a REVISION release of the latest period (label '<period>/rev1'). Rows: [date_ET, period_label] or [date_ET, period_label, time_ET].
